definitions.explanation: Goods that remain unsold after others have been bought.

examples.japanese: {売|う}れ{残|のこ}り⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦パン→パン：00553_pan⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{安|やす}く→安い：00464_yasui⟧⟦{買|か}った→買う：00489_kau⟧。
⟦セール→セール：07780_seeru⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{後|あと}→後：09580_ato⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧{売|う}れ{残|のこ}り⟦ばかり→〜ばかり：02006_bakari⟧だ。
examples.english: After the sale, there's nothing but unsold stock.

examples.japanese: ⟦{閉店|へいてん}→閉店：09698_heiten⟧⟦{間際|まぎわ}→間際：14564_magiwa⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦なる→なる：01970_naru⟧⟦と→と：00512_to⟧、{売|う}れ{残|のこ}り⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{弁当|べんとう}→弁当：01014_bentou⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{割引|わりびき}→割引：01526_waribiki⟧⟦シール→シール：09597_shiiru⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{貼|は}られる→貼る：10447_haru⟧。
examples.english: As closing time nears, discount stickers are put on the unsold boxed lunches.

notes:
The noun form of ⟦{売|う}れ{残|のこ}る→売れ残る：20923_urenokoru⟧ (to remain unsold). Refers to merchandise left over after sales.

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {売|う}れ{残|のこ}り⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{商品|しょうひん}→商品：01436_shouhin⟧: unsold merchandise
- {売|う}れ{残|のこ}り⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{処分|しょぶん}→処分：05520_shobun⟧⟦する→する：00392_suru⟧: to clear out unsold stock
- {売|う}れ{残|のこ}り⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{在庫|ざいこ}→在庫：04701_zaiko⟧: leftover inventory

USAGE:
Applied to a person — especially an unmarried woman past a certain age — {売|う}れ{残|のこ}り is rude and outdated. Avoid this use.
